{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (sentinel for missing data)
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Print the mean and the count of valid ages
print("Mean age:", mean_age)
print("Number of valid age entries:", len(valid_ages))"}
